question: The Desh Ke Mentor Programme la launched by the Delhi government in October 2021 is for the students of classes ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**IX to XII**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **"Desh Ke Mentor Programme"** was launched by the Delhi government in October 2021 to provide mentorship and guidance to students of classes 9 to 12. The program aims to support students in making informed career choices and preparing for competitive exams. Here are the key details of the scheme:
 
• Launch Date: October 2021
 
• Target Audience: Students of classes 9 to 12 in Delhi
 
• Objective: To provide mentorship, guidance, and academic support to students for making career choices and preparing for competitive exams.

**Features**:

 
• Mentorship: Students are paired with mentors who are experts in various fields. Mentors provide guidance, share their experiences, and help students with career-related queries.
 
• Interactive Sessions: The program includes interactive sessions, workshops, and webinars to provide students with insights into various career options and exam preparation strategies.
 
• Exam Guidance: Students are provided with information about competitive exams, their syllabi, preparation techniques, and time management.
 
• Soft Skills Development: Apart from academic guidance, the program also focuses on enhancing students' soft skills, communication abilities, and overall personality development.
 
• Online Platform: The program utilizes an online platform for mentor-student interactions, making it convenient for students to connect with their mentors.
 
• Personalized Support: Mentors offer personalized advice based on students' interests, strengths, and goals.
 
• Motivation: The program aims to motivate students to set ambitious goals, work hard, and achieve academic and career success.
 
• Implementation: The Desh Ke Mentor Programme is implemented through an online portal where students can register and choose mentors from different fields.
 
• Beneficiaries: Students from government and private schools in Delhi can participate in the program.
 
• Impact: The program aims to equip students with the necessary knowledge, skills, and confidence to pursue their chosen careers and excel in competitive exams.
 
• Significance: The Desh Ke Mentor Programme is a proactive step by the Delhi government to provide guidance and support to students, especially during their crucial years of education when career decisions are being made.
